units: Men. 13ᵇ מְפַגְּלֵי אהדדי each may make the other piggul.
Ib. 16ᵃ מיהדר פַּגּוּלֵי בשלישית ל״ל (not פיגולי) why is the making piggul in the third act again mentioned?; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be made piggul. Ib. 14ᵃ אילימא לאִיפַּגּוּלֵי דם דם מי מִיפַּגֵּל do you mean that the blood is to become piggul? Can blood become piggul?; לאיפגולי בשר that the flesh is to become piggul.
units: Ḥull. 58ᵇ לענין איפגולי as regards becoming piggul; a. fr.
